chain_words.nuance: to encourage someone gently towards a decision
to urge someone persistently to act
to exert influence to make someone act
to force someone to act against their will
to force someone with overwhelming power or necessity

explanation: These words all describe influencing someone to act, from a gentle nudge to an overwhelming compulsion.

usage_notes.difference: 'Pressure' describes applying influence that may still allow choice; 'coerce' means forcing someone to act against their will.
